Diverged recovery retains FRESH_EXACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED classification and requires Runtime verification plus fresh Reviewer PASS for any new source.
The test-only repair preserves Reviewer, Runtime, and Publisher boundaries and adds no semantic selection or lifecycle routing.
Typed attention schemas and non-wake publication-progress classification remain unchanged, preserving terminal/actionable attention.
The clean committed delta contains only tests/test_publication.py. The retained ingress writer rejects missing reservations with an explicit WRITER_SCOPE_GAP naming its entry point.
TASK-321 regression identities and unauthorized-main-mutation assertions remain unchanged; no force, reset, or manual rescue path was introduced.
